speaker.name: Perrin
style_phrases: opens with 'How kind.' whatever was said
colour_lines: Boats tied up after the evening bell lose their berth to whoever wants it.
The walk to the Tidewatch Lamp Room is shorter than it looks and longer than it feels.
Folk around the Salt Quay have started locking their doors early since the giant weasel turned up.
own_lines: I was fostered by a travelling puppet troupe.
I drove mules over the high roads. You learn which stretches are safe and which only look it.
A widow taught me my letters and asked only that I teach someone else. I have kept to that bargain.
Trouble does its planning in the quiet hours. So I keep an eye on the quiet.
I have one old friend, and the letters come twice a year. They are the best part of my winter.
I am saving to buy back the family stall. Every coin has a name on it.

The walk to the Tidewatch Lamp Room is shorter than it looks and longer than it feels.

I am a watch sergeant at the Tidewatch Lamp Room.
Liora sent word that you would come for the seed sack.
What matters is that you came.
You have friends here now, whether you wanted them or not.

exchanges.hero_words: Perrin? Liora sent us. What have you got for us?
exchanges.reply: How kind. Trouble does its planning in the quiet hours, so I keep an eye on the quiet. Will you hear what’s troubling me?

exchanges.hero_words: What do you know about the seed sack?
exchanges.reply: How kind. I don't know anything about the seed sack, Brakka.

exchanges.hero_words: Who is making trouble out here?
exchanges.reply: How kind. Boats tied up after the evening bell lose their berth to whoever wants it. Ask me about this place, if you want to know it.

exchanges.hero_words: What would you do in our place?
exchanges.reply: How kind. I’d take the road I knew was safe, not the one that merely looked it. What route are you weighing?

exchanges.hero_words: Where do we go from here?
exchanges.reply: How kind. Folk around the Salt Quay have started locking their doors early since the giant weasel turned up. Best be on your way now, Brakka; I would not linger.
